description: Determined which patches conflict based on files, symbols, authorities, runtimes, and routes

patch_collisions.conflict_description: PATCH_001 introduces kernel adapter interface which may require policy authorities, while PATCH_004 moves policy authorities to kernel. Both patches modify the same authority files.
patch_collisions.resolution: Execute PATCH_004 before PATCH_001 to ensure authorities are in kernel before adapter is introduced

patch_collisions.conflict_description: PATCH_001 introduces kernel adapter interface that wraps ExecutionRuntime, while PATCH_008 moves kernel runtime modules to execution boundary. Both patches modify ExecutionRuntime and DIContainer.
patch_collisions.resolution: Execute PATCH_008 before PATCH_001 to ensure kernel runtime modules are properly registered before adapter is introduced

patch_collisions.conflict_description: PATCH_002 moves EventRepository to kernel, while PATCH_003 moves EventReadAuthority to kernel. Both modify event-related files and routes.
patch_collisions.resolution: Execute PATCH_002 before PATCH_003 to ensure EventRepository is in kernel before EventReadAuthority is moved

patch_collisions.conflict_description: PATCH_002 moves EventRepository to kernel, while PATCH_009 consolidates Postgres write domains including event persistence. Both modify EventRepository.
patch_collisions.resolution: Execute PATCH_002 before PATCH_009 to ensure EventRepository is properly owned before write consolidation

patch_collisions.conflict_description: PATCH_003 moves EventReadAuthority to kernel (which depends on CanonicalAuthority), while PATCH_004 moves CanonicalAuthority to kernel. Both modify authority files.
patch_collisions.resolution: Execute PATCH_004 before PATCH_003 to ensure CanonicalAuthority is in kernel before EventReadAuthority is moved

patch_collisions.conflict_description: PATCH_005 retires or reclassifies legacy commit-service, while PATCH_009 consolidates Postgres write domains including legacy commit-service modules. Both modify the same legacy service files.
patch_collisions.resolution: Execute PATCH_005 before PATCH_009 to determine if legacy service is retired before consolidation

patch_collisions.conflict_description: PATCH_006 moves RepositoryStore to adapter role, while PATCH_009 consolidates Postgres write domains including repository persistence. Both modify RepositoryStore.
patch_collisions.resolution: Execute PATCH_006 before PATCH_009 to ensure RepositoryStore is properly classified before write consolidation

patch_collisions.conflict_description: PATCH_007 isolates Qdrant memory writes to infrastructure adapters, while PATCH_009 consolidates Postgres write domains. Both touch infrastructure but different stores (Qdrant vs Postgres).
patch_collisions.resolution: No direct conflict, can execute in parallel

patch_collisions.conflict_description: PATCH_004 moves policy authorities to kernel (which are registered in DIContainer), while PATCH_008 moves kernel runtime modules to execution boundary (which also use DIContainer). Both modify DIContainer registration.
patch_collisions.resolution: Execute PATCH_004 before PATCH_008 to ensure authorities are registered before runtime modules

patch_collisions.conflict_description: PATCH_001 introduces kernel adapter interface which affects all routes including repository routes, while PATCH_006 moves RepositoryStore to adapter role. Both modify repository routes.
patch_collisions.resolution: Execute PATCH_006 before PATCH_001 to ensure RepositoryStore is adapter before route changes

parallel_execution_groups.reason: Must be first to establish kernel authorities
Must follow PATCH_004 to register runtime modules
Must follow PATCH_008 to introduce kernel adapter
Must follow PATCH_001 to move EventRepository
Must follow PATCH_002 to move EventReadAuthority
Can execute independently after kernel is established
Can execute in parallel, different domains
Must be last to consolidate all write domains
